Card Q&A.a: Yes, it activates. This card's effect activates before your opponent blocks, therefore it can't be canceled even if a block is performed after activation.
Card Q&A.q: My Digimon attacked the opponent player and was blocked by an opponent's Digimon. Does this Digimon's effect activate in such cases?

Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your Digimon attacks a player, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
